settings.label: Show pills
settings.help: Draw a rounded shape behind each group of widgets. Off by default, so the bar keeps its stock look until you turn this on.

settings.label: Corner radius
settings.help: How round the corners are. The default is 999, which is fully round (a capsule). 0 is square.

settings.label: Match window corners
settings.help: Use the same corner rounding as your windows, so the bar and the windows look alike. Off by default. When your windows have square corners, pills are square too. While on, the corner radius setting is not used.

settings.label: Square corners at the screen edge
settings.help: The first pill on the left and the last pill on the right run to the edge of the screen with square corners on that side, so they look docked to it. On a vertical bar this is the top and the bottom. Off by default.

settings.label: Smooth movement
settings.help: When widgets change size or move, the pill glides to its new size instead of jumping. On by default. It stays off while Omarchy animations are off (omarchy toggle animations). When a group appears or goes away, the pills snap into place.

settings.label: Inner padding
settings.help: Space between the edge of a pill and the widgets inside it. The default is 12 px. A split pill uses the same, smaller padding at both ends so its icons stay centered.

settings.label: Space above and below
settings.help: Gap between a pill and the top and bottom edge of the bar. A smaller value makes pills taller, so icons have more room above and below. The default is 3 px.

settings.label: Gap between pills
settings.help: Space between one pill and the next. The default is 4 px. Widgets touch each other, so a split takes its gap out of the widgets' own edges: a larger gap makes split pills tighter around their icons.

settings.label: Fill color
settings.help: A color from your theme, so pills follow the theme when you switch it. Or type your own #rrggbb. The default is Background. On a Solid bar, Background is tinted a little toward the text color so the pills still show.

settings.label: Fill opacity
settings.help: 0 is see-through and 1 is solid. The default is 0.85.

settings.label: Border color
settings.help: Color of the thin line around a pill. Same choices as the fill color. The default is Text.

settings.label: Border opacity
settings.help: 0 hides the border and 1 is solid. The default is 0.12, a faint line.

settings.label: Border width
settings.help: Thickness of the border. 0 means no border. The default is 1 px.

settings.label: Bar background
settings.help: Solid is a plain bar, Glass lets the wallpaper show through a little, Clear has no background at all. Omarchy's default is Solid. This changes the stock Omarchy bar setting.

settings.label: Always show indicators
settings.help: Omarchy's indicators (night light, do not disturb, recording and others) show their inactive icons while the pointer is on the bar. That makes the widget wider, so the pills next to it move. On, every indicator shows all the time and nothing moves. Choose which indicators to show in the indicators widget's own settings. Off by default. This changes the stock indicators widget.

settings.label: Passwordless sudo
settings.help: Shows an icon when passwordless admin access is on. Off removes it from the bar, even while it is on. On by default.

settings.label: Screen recording
settings.help: Shows an icon when the screen is being recorded. Off removes it from the bar, even while it is on. On by default.

settings.label: Remote session
settings.help: Shows an icon when someone is connected to this computer. Off removes it from the bar, even while it is on. On by default.

settings.label: Reminder
settings.help: Shows an icon when a reminder is set. Off removes it from the bar, even while it is on. On by default.

settings.label: Night light
settings.help: Shows an icon when night light is on. Off removes it from the bar, even while it is on. On by default.

settings.label: Do not disturb
settings.help: Shows an icon when do not disturb is on. Off removes it from the bar, even while it is on. On by default.

settings.label: Stay awake
settings.help: Shows an icon when stay awake is on. Off removes it from the bar, even while it is on. On by default.
